component.name: Gatekeeper
component.summary: Choose which browser opens a link

description.p: Gatekeeper registers itself as the default browser. When a link is clicked anywhere on the desktop, in a mail client, a chat window, a terminal or a PDF viewer, Gatekeeper shows a small dialog listing the installed browsers and starts the one that is chosen.
Browsers are found regardless of how they were installed. Native packages, Flatpaks and Snaps all appear in the same list, and entries that register the same browser twice are merged into one.
The target domain is shown prominently before anything is opened, which makes it possible to see where a link actually leads while there is still time to change your mind.
